Net cash generated from operating activities surged to EUR 76.3 million in 2025 from EUR 35.6 million in 2024, primarily due to higher net profit and net favorable working capital changes.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, and K5 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K3 (segment performance details), K4 (net cash from operating activities), K6 (FSRU acquisition), and K7 (establishment of KN Energies Deutschland GmbH) are MISSING entirely. The summary covers high-level revenue, profit, operating profit drivers, and cash position changes but omits critical segment breakdowns, cash flow details, and specific corporate actions, resulting in substantial gaps in material information.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The financial performance improvements are consistently described across revenue, profit, and asset metrics. Explanations for revenue growth (S4) and offsetting factors (S5) are logically connected to the reported figures. The sequence of financial metrics (revenue → cost of sales → gross profit → operating profit → profit before tax → net profit → EPS) follows a natural accounting structure. Balance sheet items (assets, equity, borrowings, cash) are presented without internal inconsistency. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the summary forms a clear narrative from top-line growth to bottom-line results and balance sheet changes.
